column1: 這是實際執行紀錄的算術扣除，不是免編譯重跑。AOT 組每次 cell 由 host 從已驗證、移除 custom sections 的 Wasm 重新編譯，不使用 AOT cache；interpreter 保留為獨立組。剩餘時間包含模型生成、source 準備、排隊、runtime、snapshot 與 wrapper 啟動成本。舊 run 沒有完整 Cargo 起訖紀錄，顯示「量測不足」，不能回填另一輪的時間。
column2: This is an arithmetic deduction from recorded execution, not a compile-free rerun. The host recompiles each AOT cell from inspected Wasm with custom sections removed. There is no AOT cache. Interpreter remains a separate group. The remainder includes model output, source preparation, queues, runtime, snapshots, and wrapper startup. Older runs without complete Cargo records remain unavailable. Times from other tests are not substituted.

column2: Adjusted time = raw time minus merged Cargo/AOT command wall time within the selected period. A complete ledger must prove a zero deduction. Cannot calculate means the measurement is incomplete.

column1: 使用 Python kernel 的 cell.python_execute 與 Rust runner 的 cell.execution 回報值。排除模型生成、Cargo、Wasm→AOT 編譯、workspace 初始化與 snapshot。Python 重用已啟動的 kernel；Rust 每個 cell 啟動新的 WasmEdge process，包含 module 載入、VM 初始化、所選 interpreter / AOT 執行、I/O 與 host bridge 成本，並非純程式本體時間。不同版本生成的 cell 程式與次數可能不同，請一起查看呼叫數與來源。平行 cells 的合計是工作量加總，不是牆鐘時間。
column2: Uses Python cell.python_execute and Rust cell.execution values. Excludes model output, Cargo, AOT compilation, workspace initialization, and snapshots. Python reuses a running kernel. Each Rust cell starts a new WasmEdge process. Its time includes module load, VM setup, interpreter/AOT execution, I/O, and the host bridge. This is not guest-body time alone. Check cell counts and sources: generated programs can differ. Parallel cell totals measure work, not task wall time.
